summary: The FOMC wrapped its July 28-29 meeting today, with the policy statement released at 2:00 p.m. ET and Chair Warsh's press conference at 2:30 p.m. The backdrop is a hawkish one — the June dot plot pointed to a median year-end rate of 3.8%, up from 3.4% in March, with the market split on whether a hike follows.
tweet: Fed decision day: Warsh speaks at 2:30 p.m. ET against a hawkish dot-plot backdrop, while a global chip sell-off keeps tech on the defensive.
